records.name: Urbonas
records.facts_used: Urbonas: Lithuanian Urbonas continues Roman Urbanus. Latin urbanus means of the city or urban and derives from urbs, city. The name later also became a surname, but given-name and surname evidence must remain distinct. Salys describes this baptismal name as fairly common in sixteenth-century Lithuania. He cites Urban in the Lithuanian Metrica in 1510. The document’s spelling is retained: this is not a first registration of the exact modern form Urbonas.
records.reason: Exact-form or explicitly scoped family evidence supports two paragraphs in five languages.
records.uncertainties: Original Salys PDF 152–153/printed 137–138 exact Urbonas chapter andoriginal 1510 Urban spelling verified visually. No surname date imported as given-name first use.
